talk.title: PyCon Taiwan

speakers.name: petertc
speakers.biography: PyCon Taiwan volunteer. You might spot me at some random Python or open source events around the world. https://x.com/petertc_chu

talk.abstract: PyCon Taiwan is a vibrant and welcoming Python community dedicated to promoting Python and open-source culture in Taiwan. Since 2012, our annual conference has brought together developers, educators, and enthusiasts to share knowledge, connect, and collaborate. This poster will introduce the history, values, and activities of PyCon Taiwan, highlight successful community projects, and explore opportunities for cross-border collaboration between the Taiwan and Japan Python communities.
talk.motivation: By introducing our community, I hope to encourage cross-border friendships and new opportunities for cooperation.
talk.takeaway: I want to encourage people to share their knowledge and connect with the worldwide Python community. I believe PyCon Taiwan is a great first stop for anyone interested in joining a welcoming, active, and globally connected group.
